thread:
Avery: Quick recap from today's pin-schema sync. Need a short decision so RFC can land. Key areas: compatibility expression, TTL semantics, observe-only canaries, and provenance sanitization.

Kai: My preference: explicit compat_bands (string ranges) + numeric priority. Deterministic routing is a must. Example: `compat_bands: [{\"min\": \"1.2.0\", \"max\": \"1.4.x\", \"priority\": 100}]`

Marta: Add `provenance` + `provenance_sanitized` flag. We must never show raw env keys in Console. Also `safety_tags` string[] so UI can opt-lock pins tied to regulated features.

Devon: Ops: define tie-breaker. Proposal: higher priority wins; ties => earlier `created_at` wins. If no band matches, obey `fallback_policy` (tenant_default | route_variant | fail_fast).

Avery: Minimal schema sketch (inline):

```json
{
  "pin_id": "acct-123/stable",
  "schema_version": "1",
  "mode": "soft",
  "ttl_seconds": "86400",
  "observe_only": "false",
  "compat_bands": "[{\"min\":\"1.2.0\",\"max\":\"1.4.9\",\"priority\":100}]",
  "fallback_policy": "tenant_default",
  "origin": "rollout-service",
  "provenance_sanitized": "true",
  "confidence": "0.88",
  "safety_tags": "[\"no-cache\"]",
  "deprecated_by": ""
}
```

Kai: minor: use strings for versions to avoid parsing bugs.

Marta: add optional `allowed_routes` to limit sensitive pins to dedicated pools.

Devon: Console tasks: surface pin_id, origin, confidence, observe_only, safety_tags; alert when observe-only pins carry >X% traffic.

release-bot: dry-run scheduled for acct-123 at 1799990015.

Avery: Action items: 1) I'll author RFC with schema, tie-breaker pseudocode, and sanitization rules. 2) Kai will add `allow_unstable` flag suggestion to RFC. 3) Devon will create console ticket and alerts. Marta to review sanitization. Target RFC draft by EOD Wed.

Marta: I'll watch for any fields that could leak secrets. Suggest server-side sanitizer that strips keys matching /(KMS|HSM|SECRET|TOKEN)/i.

Avery: Good call. We'll redact by default and surface `provenance_sanitized=true`. Thanks all. :coffee:
